items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: then in the 60s Bob Dylan, Bruce Springsteen.

ctx.x: No. That’s what I talk about in my class and that’s where integration — when John Hammond, who I’m sure you know, knew, or know of — well I was lucky enough to know John Hammond. He worked at two labels, Columbia and Vanguard. I worked at two labels, Columbia and Vanguard. And I got to know Mr. Hammond in the 80s. He died in ’87. But he was the guy who integrated the Goodman band in 1935 by getting him to hire Teddy Wilson and then Lionel Hampton and then Charlie Christian. And he told me stories that are just…
